title: Toddler Siblings on Rural Farm, Pasture - Vintage 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A vertical full-length outdoor portrait of two young siblings standing together in a grassy, low-vegetation field on a farm. The older boy wears a striped long-sleeve shirt under dark denim overalls, shyly holding his hand to his mouth. Beside him, a young girl with a bow in her hair smiles at the camera, dressed in a light-colored short-sleeved collared romper. In the far background, rural farm outbuildings and utility poles sit beneath an expansive, washed-out sky, capturing quintessential Mid-century rural American childhood.
